files.note: Changed between the releases only in the shipped build: 9.0.0 no longer emits source maps, so dist/modules/cases.js lost its trailing sourceMappingURL comment. The source is unchanged, so the claim stands.
Changed between the releases only in the shipped build: 9.0.0 no longer emits source maps, so dist/url.js lost its trailing sourceMappingURL comment. The source is unchanged, so the claim stands.

Bulk writes now validate their case IDs, bulk add checks for an empty array, list timestamps are checked, and soft-delete mode is captured before dispatch. The configured bindings and accepted request shapes still match.
The URL builder also omits null inputs from untyped callers. Accepted query values retain their ordering and scalar, repeated, or comma-separated encoding.

sources.supports: getCaseTitles refuses an empty list, validates every member as an identifier, joins them with commas as the case_ids query control of get_case_titles, and parses the reply as an array of CaseTitleSchema records. The driver documents the endpoint as TestRail 10.5 or later.
buildEndpoint appends the control path-style after an ampersand and percent-encodes the value, so the joining commas are sent as %2C.

The 10.5.1 release notes introduce get_case_titles as a lightweight call mapping a list of case IDs to their titles. The Cases API reference does not yet document it, so the driver is the source for its request shape.

input_policy.notes: Strictness is an MCP boundary requirement. The identifier list is the only input and it lives in query, where TestRail reads it.

outer_result.notes: The driver returns the array of id/title projections as received; entity-field drift is advisory.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.
Reject an unsupported query key rather than discarding it.
Reject an input without the query container; the list is required.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The validated list is passed positionally as the only driver argument and sent comma-joined as the case_ids control.

wire.encoding: case_ids=<ids joined by commas, percent-encoded as %2C> appended path-style.
